sections.description: WordPress Corporate WDA is a fully responsive and feature-rich theme developed by our team. It will be an excellent solution for those who plan to create a corporate website from scratch or update the design of an existing website, giving it a fresh and beautiful look. The WordPress Corporate theme has a lot of great features, so let us talk about them in more detail. This theme is SEO optimized and well structured. Another advantage of our theme is ready-made sections and patterns, developed specifically for corporate, business, and similar sites. It comes with a powerful and well-designed homepage. The homepage contains thirteen different sections that are sure to impress your site visitors. Here are the available sections: Banner, Call to Action, Achievements, Team Members, Advantages, Parallax Effect, Sales, Benefits of Ordering, Our Partners, Shop by Category,  Services, Testimonials, and Latest Posts. All these sections have a unique design and are fully customizable. This means that you can change any standard content/element or its design. The WordPress Corporate theme has a convenient option that allows you to change the size of the site layout and choose from three available sizes: standard, wide, and full width. It is also worth noting that this option can be selected separately for different parts of the site: top header, main header, main container, and footer. The WordPress Corporate WDA theme is fully integrated with WooCommerce. This means that you can easily turn your website into an online store and sell products online. We've added a lot of options specifically for the store pages, from design options to a product search bar and header cart options. The WordPress Corporate theme extends the standard functionality of the WooCommerce plugin, which is another advantage. There are other benefits we could mention, but it would be better if you install the Corporate theme and test it yourself, or visit the theme demo page and see it in action.
